title: Linguistic Relativity and the Inner Form: Innere Sprachform

sections.title: Philosophical & Societal Framework
sections.content: Wilhelm von Humboldt famously asserted that language is not a completed product (*ergon*), but a living, creative activity (*energeia*). Each human tongue possesses a distinctive 'inner form' (*innere Sprachform*) that channels how sensations are transformed into concepts.

sections.title: Linguistic Analysis
sections.content: When writing about linguistic philosophy in Hungarian, notice how nominal derivations (-ás/-és) and relational compounds (*szemléletmód, világkép, fogalomalkotás*) allow dense conceptual synthesis: *A nyelv nem passzív közvetítő eszköz, hanem a gondolkodás aktív alakítója.*
